notes.title: Help Me! Is now on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41617585/cbc2623740bd3ec6eb474540124d0e03aac7390d.png[/img]

Today we are pleased to officially launch the Kickstarter campaign of the new IP, which is the result of cooperation between Madmind Studio and Black Rat Studio.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madmind/help-me-1

We invite you to watch the new trailer of the game, and to play the demo version, available to players who decide to support HELP ME!

[previewyoutube=My_UH111VWs;full][/previewyoutube]


For Madmind Studio, the Kickstarter campaign was a special moment in the history of the company. It is thanks to the successfully completed fundraiser - Agony, that we were able to bring the project to an end, and expand the game universe, and over time also enlarge our team. 

Help me! is a horror game that will allow you to play as Maxim - the main character of the game who is trying to find his missing father.

Traveling through the world of nightmares and fears, the hero will discover the dark secrets of his family, which have been hidden from the world for years. 

The game uses the latest technologies, such as photogrammetry, which allows you to achieve a photorealistic visual setting, thanks to the Unreal Engine 5 graphics engine.

We invite you to familiarize yourself with the gallery presenting HELP ME! and to visit the game's Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833770/HELP_ME/
